chapters.reason: The paper explicitly uses meta-reinforcement learning to optimize test-time compute without introducing explicit length penalties, relying on dense reward bonuses based on progress.
The paper focuses on optimizing test-time compute by treating the output stream as a sequence of episodes, which aligns with scaling compute dynamically during inference.
The paper introduces a new metric (cumulative regret over output tokens) to measure the efficacy of test-time compute, which is central to the evaluation of their proposed method.
